findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Temukan Ikan Hias Impian & Rawat Akuarium dengan" → 3 lines (10 words, 54px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Navigasi Cepat" above "Kategori Produk"; "Pilihan Penangkar Terkurasi" (pill) above "Koleksi Ikan Hias & Mutasi Morph Terbaru"; "Edukasi & Perawatan" above "Panduan Kesehatan Ikan & Kualitas Air"; "Buka Toko Penangkar Ikan" (pill) above "Apakah Anda Pembudidaya atau Penjual Ika"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 6 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Kategori:", "Navigasi Cepat", "Edukasi & Perawatan", "Katalog Utama").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ♂
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): div.bg-gradient-to-r.from-dunia-navy → linear-gradient(to right, rgb(13, 46, 146), rgb(30, 128, 160)) | section.relative.overflow-hidden → linear-gradient(rgba(240, 249, 255, 0.7), rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(255, 255, 255)) | div.rounded-3xl.bg-gradient-to-r → linear-gradient(to right, rgb(13, 46, 146), rgb(30, 128, 160), rgb(6, 132, 229))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 6 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.w-11.h-11 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(6, 132, | a.px-4.py-2 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | a.px-7.py-3.5 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(6, 132,
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 21 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.sticky.top-0 1440px | div.hidden.md:flex 1216px | section.relative.overflow-hidden 1440px | div.pt-6.grid 512px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 20 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 3 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 5, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "6 Produk" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "2 Produk" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "2 Produk" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "2 Produk" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 48 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Broken image(s): https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544943910-4c1dc44a0b27?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80, https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544943910-4c1dc44a0b27?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80
findings.fix: Fix the URL or replace the asset.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 54px (3.8vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Hanken Grotesk and Hanken Grotesk, but the page renders Plus Jakarta Sans.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: Only 2 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 16px from the left edge but only to 136px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
